cohort: The study cohort included 56,557 singletons and 16,315 twins born after fresh IVF/ICSI cycles and 2,808,323 spontaneously conceived singletons from Denmark, Norway, and Sweden.
finding: Fresh blastocyst transfer was associated with a higher risk of placenta previa, preterm birth, an altered male/female ratio with more males, and a higher risk of same-sex twins after single embryo transfer, compared to fresh cleavage stage transfer.
gest_age: Gestational age was calculated for all participants based on oocyte pick-up date or second-trimester ultrasonography to determine preterm birth.
